items.title: Why Apple Needs Intel to Overcome Supply Worries
items.summary: Apple stock was falling Friday as limited supply of chips held back its outlook.  The solution could lie with Intel, according to Melius Research.  Apple shares were down 8% in the premarket as shortages of memory chips and other processors limited the iPhone market's guidance for the September quarter.

items.title: Apple, Amazon, Roblox, Microsoft, Marvell, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Amazon  jumped more than 12% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.  Alphabet  and  Meta Platforms  were both punished by the market after hiking capex this earnings season.  The spending hike is good news for  Marvell Technology  as it helps design Amazon’s artificial-intelligence chips.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Apple, Amazon, SK Hynix, Samsung, Roblox
items.summary: ↗️ SK Hynix (KR:000660), Samsung (KR:005930): Shares of both chipmakers surged over 25% in Asian trading, staging a strong recovery after a turbulent week. Peers Marvell (MRVL), Intel (INTC), Micron (MU), also moved higher.

items.title: Intel (INTC) Just Expanded Its Foundry Tool Kit For AI Chip Customers
items.summary: Synopsys and Keysight Technologies have certified advanced EDA and electromagnetic simulation tools for Intel's latest 14A and 18A P foundry nodes. The certification expands Intel Foundry's design ecosystem for AI and high performance computing customers using these advanced manufacturing processes.
